versions.changelog:
- No user-facing changes in this version.
- No file changes were detected.
- Functionality and usage remain unchanged from the previous version.

- Initial release of "long-image-to-pdf" skill.
- Slices long images (e.g., chat screenshots, web page captures) into overlapping segments and arranges them in a paginated PDF.
- Supports custom slice height, overlap amount, grid layout (columns, rows), and output file naming.
- Includes automatic cleanup of intermediate slices by default.
- Provides clear command-line usage instructions and best practices, such as always using absolute paths.
